title: Fragments of the Alexander historians (FGrH/BNJ 117–153: Callisthenes, Chares, Ephippus, Onesicritus, Nearchus, Aristobulus, Cleitarchus, Ptolemy, Ephemerides) / Фрагменты историков Александра
author: Various; transmitted by Arrian, Strabo, Plutarch, Athenaeus and others
ru_status: none as a collected, annotated corpus. Individual fragments sit inside host authors that do have Russian translations (Arrian, Strabo, Plutarch).
en_status: full (C. A. Robinson, The History of Alexander the Great I, 1953; Brill's New Jacoby online). From memory, not re-verified in this pass.
ru_evidence: The ru.wikipedia articles Онесикрит, Клитарх and Аристобул из Кассандрии (https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Онесикрит, …/Клитарх, …/Аристобул_из_Кассандрии) cite only the Russian translations of the host authors (Sergeenko, Stratanovsky, Gasparov, Markish). value: This is the editor's own field and the evidential base behind the Alexander Romance problem. It is ideal for commentary-led AI translation and for a visible model-to-model review of source criticism. Avoid duplicating P.Oxy. 1798 = FGrH 148, which is already in the papyri dossier.
